description:
Validate vault files against the schemas directory.

Usage:
  [PATHS...] [--schemas DIR] [--quiet]

Args:
  PATHS — files to validate; with none given, walks the whole vault

Flags:
  --schemas directory holding the schema files; defaults to the schemas directory shipped with the tool
  --quiet suppress per-violation output, leaving only the exit code

Examples:
  []
  ["--quiet"]
  ["notes/2026-06-15-14-30-00.md"]

Notes:
  Violations print as <path>:<line>: <message>. Exit 0 means clean, 1 means violations were found, 2 means the run itself failed.
  Read-only; it never modifies files. Run it after any vault mutation and before `commit save`.
